batch_plan.rule: Use source-bound _stratum_groups, _life_uniform_indices and _sample_batch_indices; sorted life groups, original ordered row indices; draw 128 doom then 128 ordinary life-uniform rows for update 0..1999. Materialize 512000 identities once after selection before either fit, bind one plan hash and initial/final generator states to both arms; COV never regenerates or re-stratifies it.

historical_limitations: Historical installed builds/CPU and original serialized configuration/RNG/continuation may remain unknown permanently. COV requires lawful exact restore/parity or HOLD_COVERAGE_IMPLEMENTATION; P/W do not require historical continuation reconstruction.
